question: What initiation arises when the teacher properly looks upon the disciple?
premises: The teacher properly sees the disciple.
This act constitutes a named initiation.
The address is to the beloved.
inference: When the teacher properly looks at the disciple, that is dṛgdīkṣā.
plain_english: If the teacher properly looks upon the disciple, that would be sight-initiation, O beloved.
